prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1125; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the other driver struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this collision and has retained this office to protect their legal rights and to pursue appropriate compensation.

Please direct all future communications regarding this matter, including any requests for statements, recorded or otherwise, to this office and not to our client. Our client is not to be contacted directly by you or by anyone acting on your behalf.

We request that you provide the policy limits of all liability coverage applicable to the insured driver, along with a copy of the declarations page for each policy in force at the time of the collision.

Please also take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, vehicle data, telematics and event data recorder information, dash camera footage, claim file materials, witness statements, and any recorded calls. Failure to preserve such evidence may result in serious consequences in any resulting litigation.

We look forward to your prompt written confirmation of receipt of this letter.
